capabilities: Drag task cards between seven day columns to reschedule them
Track habits, weekly priorities and per-category task lists in a sidebar
Log planned versus actual hours per task and per category
View weekly totals and a daily planned-vs-actual bar chart
Archive weeks to Markdown and back up or restore board data as JSON
extras: Manual install by copying manifest.json, main.js and styles.css; README warns to quit Obsidian before installing or the plugin files can be overwritten; includes offline test scripts in test/; works on desktop and mobile (drag needs long-press); no network access or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in week-view board for planning task cards across the days of a week with hours, habits and stats.
